title: DeepSeek AI Released DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash with 1M Context, FP4 KV Cache, and Cross-Layer Attention Reuse
content:
Long-horizon agents have turned LLM serving into an input-heavy workload. Repeated prefills and million-token contexts leave KV caches that strain HBM, SSD capacity, and bandwidth. DeepSeek AI built its newest release around that exact bottleneck. DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is a multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model with 552B backbone parameters, 196B additional Engram parameters, and a 1M-token context window. It […]

The post
author: Asif Razzaq
ai_summary: DeepSeek AI发布了DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，这是一个拥有552B主干参数和196B额外Engram参数的多模态MoE模型，支持100万token上下文窗口。该模型引入了FP4 KV缓存和跨层注意力复用技术，专门针对长上下文推理中的HBM和SSD带宽瓶颈进行了优化。这些技术创新使其特别适合长程Agent任务场景。
